description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
